stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard plan review [-h]
                                     {start,verdict,respond,status,abandon,decide,close,report,tick} ...

positional arguments:
  {start,verdict,respond,status,abandon,decide,close,report,tick}
    start               Open a review of a plan for its ask and launch the
                        lanes
    verdict             (fallback) a lane records its verdict block for its
                        own lane
    respond             The planner answers a finished round: response table
                        and the new revision
    status              Rounds, lanes, open objections and the tally
    abandon             Clear a stalled open review (the round count
                        continues)
    decide              Resolve an escalated objection: accept it, or override
                        it with a reason
    close               The closing round: every lane confirms the final
                        revision, then the consensus is recorded
    report              What the review cost and what the reviewers caught
    tick                Housekeeping: relaunch a stuck lane once, then
                        escalate it; remind an undecided escalation

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
